description.en: Devices publish arbitrary field IDs using sensor-data schema 2, with a name, type, unit, value, validity flag and reading age (`name/type/unit/value/valid/age_ms`). TC1 power, A1 effective main-fan output, and DAIKIN and M1 sensor readings declare `number`. A1 output is 0–100%, not RPM. Invalid values use `null` instead of a fabricated zero. Sensor data now uses schema 2 and M1 display profiles use schema 4, without compatibility with the corresponding v1.0.0-rc interfaces. Custom clients must follow the RC1 protocol and use the matching frontend.
description.zh-CN: 设备以传感器数据 schema 2 发布任意字段 ID 及其名称、类型、单位、数值、有效标志和读数年龄（`name/type/unit/value/valid/age_ms`）。TC1 功率、A1 主风机生效输出、大金和 M1 的传感器读数均声明为 `number`；A1 输出为 0–100%，不是 RPM。无效数值使用 `null`，不以 0 代替。 本版传感器数据采用 schema 2、M1 显示配置采用 schema 4，不兼容 v1.0.0-rc 的对应旧接口；自定义调用方需按 RC1 协议调整，并使用配套前端。

description.en: M1 display-profile schema 4 selects a source by device and field, rather than adapting to its model. New numeric fields do not need another model mapping. M1 accepts only `number` fields matching the configured type and unit. Missing, invalid, `unknown` or other nonnumeric fields revoke the old reading; the protocol reserves future type extensions. Sensor data now uses schema 2 and M1 display profiles use schema 4, without compatibility with the corresponding v1.0.0-rc interfaces. Custom clients must follow the RC1 protocol and use the matching frontend.

description.en: When an incompatible configuration requires confirmation, M1 rejects a network-only reset instead of reporting success or acknowledging success to the controller. Stored bytes remain intact until a full clear is explicitly confirmed in the page. Full clearing still checks the storage commit, allows retry after failure and blocks further writes when the commit result is uncertain. No automatic migration for unknown third-party layouts is added.

description.en: The full and minimal setup pages refresh recovery state. After an explicitly confirmed clear, they wait for restart and reconnection before retiring the old migration warning and updating the form in the same tab. Duplicate submissions are blocked while waiting, failures can be retried, and a restart that still requires recovery is reported as an unconfirmed clear. Ordinary refreshes preserve unsaved input.

description.en: A1 reserves two Wi-Fi recovery sequences: tap twice, hold the third touch for 1–2 seconds and release to reset networking; tap three times, hold the fourth touch for 1–2 seconds and release to factory reset. Release each short tap, leave less than 0.3 seconds between touches and hold the final touch for at least 1 second and less than 5 seconds. Recovery runs only when the panel reports release, bypasses child lock and suppresses custom click and hold actions for this sequence. Existing 5 / 10 second recovery holds remain. Factory reset clears user settings. The new sequences await physical acceptance.
description.zh-CN: A1 Wi-Fi 键新增保留恢复组合：短按两次，第 3 次按住 1–2 秒后松手重置网络；短按三次，第 4 次按住 1–2 秒后松手恢复出厂。每次短按须松手，相邻触碰间隔小于 0.3 秒，最终按住至少 1 秒、不足 5 秒，面板报告松开才触发。绕过童锁，不执行本组连击或最终长按的自定义动作；原 5 秒 / 10 秒恢复手势保留。恢复出厂清除用户设置。新增手势尚未实机验收。
